entities.summary: Zheng Xuan, courtesy name Kangcheng, was a Chinese philosopher, politician, and writer who lived towards the end of the Eastern Han dynasty. He was born in Gaomi, Beihai Commandery, and was a student of Ma Rong, together with Lu Zhi.
